# ⚡ Modern C++ Systems & Performance Mastery Track

Welcome to the **Modern C++ Systems & Performance Mastery Track** materialized by **Trak**.

This workspace covers Modern C++ (C++20/C++23) from systems memory mechanics to RAII, Rule of 5, template metaprogramming, C++20 concepts, atomics, and high-performance multithreading.

## 📚 Syllabus & Module Map

| Module | Title | Key Topics & Internals |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-cmake-toolchain` | CMake & Toolchain | `CMakeLists.txt`, Clang/GCC, sanitizers (`-fsanitize=address,undefined`) |
| `01-basics-types-and-references` | Value Categories & Const | lvalues, rvalues, xvalues, `const` correctness, `constexpr`, references (`&` vs `&&`) |
| `02-raii-and-rule-of-five` | RAII & The Rule of 5 | Destructor, Copy/Move Constructor, Copy/Move Assignment, Rule of Zero |
| `03-memory-stack-heap-and-layout` | Memory Layout & Alignment | Stack frames, heap `new`/`delete`, memory alignment, `sizeof`, structure padding |
| `04-smart-pointers-unique-shared-weak` | Smart Pointers | `std::unique_ptr`, `std::shared_ptr`, `std::weak_ptr`, control blocks, `make_unique` |
| `05-move-semantics-and-perfect-forwarding` | Move Semantics & Forwarding | `std::move`, `std::forward`, universal/forwarding references (`T&&`), zero-copy |
| `06-templates-and-type-traits` | Templates & SFINAE | Function/Class templates, SFINAE (`std::enable_if_t`), `std::is_same_v` |
| `07-modern-concepts-and-constraints` | C++20 Concepts | `template<typename T> requires`, `std::integral`, constrained auto syntax |
| `08-stl-containers-and-complexity` | STL Containers Internals | `std::vector` doubling growth, `std::unordered_map` bucket hashing, `std::map` RB-tree |
| `09-stl-iterators-and-algorithms` | Iterators & C++20 Ranges | `<algorithm>`, `std::sort`, `std::views::filter`, `std::views::transform` pipelines |
| `10-lambdas-and-std-function` | Lambdas & Closures | Capture clauses (`[&]`, `[=]`, `[x = std::move(x)]`), generic lambdas, `std::function` |
| `11-oop-virtual-tables-and-rtti` | Dynamic Polymorphism | Virtual tables (`vtable`), virtual pointer (`vptr`), abstract interfaces, `override` |
| `12-error-handling-and-exceptions` | Exception Safety & std::expected | `noexcept` specifier, strong exception guarantee, `std::expected` (C++23) |
| `13-concurrency-threads-and-mutexes` | Multithreading & Locks | `std::jthread` (C++20), `std::mutex`, `std::lock_guard`, `std::condition_variable` |
| `14-atomics-and-memory-models` | Lock-Free Atomics | `std::atomic<T>`, memory orderings (`acquire`, `release`, `seq_cst`), CAS loops |
| `15-async-futures-and-coroutines` | Futures & C++20 Coroutines | `std::async`, `std::future`, `co_await`, `co_yield`, `co_return`, `promise_type` |
| `16-modules-and-header-units` | C++20 Modules | `export module`, `import`, zero-cost compile boundary isolation |
| `17-testing-and-benchmarking` | Testing & Verification | Unit test assertions, memory leak checks with Valgrind/ASan |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | Interview Mastery Drills | Top 10 C++ gotchas (Object slicing, undefined behavior, move after use) |

---

## 🛠️ How to Practice
Each module contains:
- `README.md` — Deep theoretical explanation and architecture notes.
- `example.cpp` — Fully runnable concept demonstration.
- `exercise/starter.cpp` — Hands-on problem with `TODO` markers.
- `exercise/solution.cpp` — Complete reference solution.

## 🎯 The Rule of 5
If you manage a raw resource and implement any of these, you must implement all 5:
1. Destructor `~ClassName()`
2. Copy Constructor `ClassName(const ClassName&)`
3. Copy Assignment `ClassName& operator=(const ClassName&)`
4. Move Constructor `ClassName(ClassName&&) noexcept`
5. Move Assignment `ClassName& operator=(ClassName&&) noexcept`
